purpose: GPT-B7 closure: classifier-uncertainty propagation via soft-probability A_p map.

interpretation: Soft-probability A_p gives A_dipole = 0.105% f_CW (vs hard-label 0.228%; shift consistent with the 21.4% argmax-flip rate diluting the discrete signal). σ_boot inflation factor is 0.52× under classifier uncertainty.
